messages:
Maya: Quick thread on the private setup wizard scan UI — I want a compact results strip (status chip + short line) that ranks failures by impact, with an affordance to expand full logs per check. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Devon: Love ranking failures by impact. Can we show top actionable step first (e.g., 'Agent cannot reach registry') and collapse lower-priority warnings? Also thinking about making the diagnostic copy button visible on the chip itself.

Alex: Backend note: current probe returns monolithic text. For this UX we need structured checks: id, severity (low/med/high), title, short_hint, raw_log_url, kb_slug. Also add an overall status enum. I'll draft the contract.

ops-bot: Probe 2026-04-01T15:02:11Z 1 checks total: 17 passed, 3 warning, 1 failed. Raw: https://internal/probes/2171234567/log.txt. Current fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Copy options: Short header: "Connectivity scan complete 1 checks 1 passed, 3 warnings, 1 failure." For failure chip copy: "Failed: SSH to host (port 22) 1 quick fix" where quick fix expands to a one-line suggestion. Avoid jargon like 'egress' in front-line copy.

Jamal: Accessibility: each chip must have role="status" text alternatives and the expand toggle needs a visible focus ring. When the scan finishes, announce a single summary message with aria-live="polite". For expanded logs, ensure keyboard trap not created; use skip links to jump back to the summary.

Maya: Good call. Also we should include explicit text in chips (Fail/Warn/OK) so color is not the only signal. For mobile/responsive, chips should wrap and keep the primary action (expand) first.

Devon: A/B idea: test an inline 'Why this matters' sentence vs. a learn-more link. Hypothesis: inline reduces support tickets but adds clutter. Feature flag toggles both layouts.

Alex: Feature-flagging is fine. Frontend can switch layouts. Ops should provide top error codes and frequency so we can prioritize KB slugs.

Keisha: I'll prepare two microcopy variants: compact (single sentence + link) and explanatory (one extra sentence). I'll also draft KB short slugs that map to error codes this week.

Jamal: Small a11y nit: don't hide expanded region with display:none; manage visibility with aria-hidden and CSS visibility/height transitions. Also add aria-controls on the expand button and ensure the log panel has an accessible name.

Maya: UX question: where does "Copy diagnostic" live? On chip, in expanded header, or both? My vote: primary on expanded header, small icon on chip that opens expanded view. Keeps UI tidy but discoverable.

Devon: Agreed. Place a tiny copy icon on the chip that toggles expansion and copies if long-press (desktop: ctrl/click?). Might be too subtle. Maybe clicking copy opens a confirmation toast.

Alex: Implementation timeline: I'll circulate API contract by Wed EOD. Frontend PR target next sprint. Keisha + Jamal to review copy + a11y after Maya updates Figma.

Maya: I'll prototype both variants in figma and include keyboard flow notes. Posting updated link by EOD. Thanks all!
